summary: Frontend-only testing of all 4 new features (Hekim Kayıt Akışı, Turdan Vakaya Geçiş, Kurum Başvurusu, Hızlı Komut Paleti) plus airy UI pass. 8/8 critical flows passed on preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: Signup.jsx (~165 lines) is well-scoped: step validation is step-local, docs limited to 3, 10MB cap enforced, Dr. prefix dedup handled, workspace & cases reset correctly for new user (empty personal workspace).
store.submitSignup replaces existing 'me' physician via filter→prepend; safe for repeat signups. importTour imports the pending tour as a new case with context message and clears pendingTour.
LoginDialog correctly branches: pendingTour + physician → importTour and navigate to /arastirma/<id>; admin path ignores pendingTour (expected).
OrgContact: Pydantic-style client validation OK; prototype note is clear. Admin orgs tab shows empty state when none; status toggle to 'İletişime geçildi' works and persists via localStorage.

CommandPalette correctly hides physician-only groups in admin workspace (only command-admin visible); dynamic search for 'amok' surfaces evidence/med quick actions and PRODUCTS filtered by cmdk; shortcut Ctrl+K and topbar-search-button both open the palette.
Profile reupload input re-triggers 'İnceleniyor' status and re-queues the applicant in admin queue.
Minor: Signup Field label wraps <input> in <label> (OK but the hidden file input is also inside the dropzone button→label chain; works but accessibility could prefer explicit htmlFor). Non-blocking.
test_credentials: none - prototype (localStorage only). Demo logins via landing-login-button → login-as-physician / login-as-admin.
context_for_next_testing_agent: localStorage key: medassistix-prototype-v1; sessionStorage: medassistix-tour-used. Signup path /kayit (4 steps). Tour carry via tour-carry-button or tour-limit-carry-button → opens login-dialog with login-tour-notice; login-as-physician imports tour to /arastirma/<newid>. Signup with pendingTour auto-imports after submit. Admin tabs: overview/queue/accounts/orgs/workspaces/logs. CommandPalette: Ctrl+K; in admin workspace only command-admin shows; dynamic command-evidence-search & command-med-search appear when q.length>1 in personal.

test_results.signup_empty_personal_workspace: PASS (sidebar user shows Dr. prefix, no cases)
